main_text: EOSC Node | European Digital Twin Ocean This EOSC Thematic Node originated from the Blue-Cloud initiative, which de-facto piloted a marine thematic node to advance high-quality marine science Sign In Register Welcome! Access the rich world of this EOSC thematic node via the user-friendly D4Science platform . If you already have an account, simply sign in using your existing credentials, including those in the EOSC AAI federation. Creating an account is quick and easy. Join us on our Open Science journey in the marine domain!
